column1: # Standalone rule (2026-10-31): executables and build hooks retired because they checked out, built against or
# fetched from another repository. ARCHIVE_MOVE: byte-identical git mv into the retained archive (never deleted;
# check_standalone.py counts the archive as L_ARCHIVE lineage). PROFILE_RETIRED: the pom profile was removed;
# git_blob is the pre-image pom blob. Reason codes: GH_API_FETCH (gh api reads of the donor's develop branch),
# DONOR_CHECKOUT_BUILD (the build stages sources from a donor checkout), EXTERNAL_PLUGIN_ARTIFACT (a plugin
# dependency that no module of this repository builds).
